title: Mud Mephit Wing

sources.title: Suspension of Muddy Goo
markers: | description = '''Suspension of Muddy Goo''' is an [[Alchemy|Alchemical Extraction]]. It can be combined with any [[Alchemy#Extractions|Sublimate]] to create {{SmRarityItem|Elixir of Poison Resistance}}.

sources.title: Elixir of Poison Resistance
markers: | description = {{uncommon|Elixir of Poison Resistance}} is an uncommon [[Elixirs|Elixir]] that grants {{DamageType|Poison}} [[Damage Types#Resistance|Resistance]] when consumed.

summary: Extract three Mud Mephit Wings into Suspension of Muddy Goo. Mix with any Sublimate to brew Elixir of Poison Resistance.

fields.Use: Extract three Mud Mephit Wings into Suspension of Muddy Goo. Mix with any Sublimate to brew Elixir of Poison Resistance.
fields.Base value: 3 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
